content_sections.heading: SCI Senior Personal Assistant Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of four stages: an Objective Type Test containing multiple-choice questions, a Shorthand (English) Test, a Typing Speed Test on Computer, and an Interview. Stage 1: Objective Type Test (100 marks, 1.5 hours) containing questions on General English, General Knowledge, provisions relating to the Judiciary in the Constitution of India, Supreme Court Rules 2013, and Knowledge of Computer operation. Minimum qualifying marks: 50. Stage 2: Shorthand (English) Test at the speed of 110 words per minute (7 minutes dictation, 45 minutes transcription). Maximum marks: 100, minimum qualifying marks: 50. Stage 3: Typing Speed Test on Computer in English language with minimum speed of 40 w.p.m. (duration: 10 minutes). Maximum marks: 20, minimum qualifying marks: 10. Stage 4: Interview (Maximum marks: 30, minimum qualifying marks: 15).

content_sections.text: The scheme of examination for the tests is detailed below: There will be no negative marking in the Objective Type Test. Permissible mistakes for Shorthand Test: 5% of total words dictated. Permissible mistakes for Typing Speed Test: 3% of total words typed.
